ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels localized primarily at the margins and central peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) contiguous banding along the entire trailing edge and tips. A prominent, irregular low-intensity vertical patch extends from the base of the median notch toward the lower center. Discrete low-intensity circular spots (mottling) are distributed across the high-intensity (white) surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-to-U shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of approximately 30-40 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular micro-serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and valleys indicative of wear or trauma.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broadly concave curve from the tips toward the median notch, while the overall lobe shape exhibits a horizontal convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Three distinct dark circular pixel clusters are visible on the left lobe (medial region); multiple smaller, faded circular clusters are scattered on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, horizontal low-intensity linear mark is visible on the far-left distal lobe tip, cutting through the high-intensity field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch and jagged loss of material on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe, differing in symmetry and amplitude from the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation patch has a highly unique 'ink-blot' morphology with jagged, pixelated edges where it interfaces with the white ventral surface.
